An '''air tank''' was a container used to store [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] or other equivalent [[Gas/Legends|gases]]. They were available to purchase in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and generally cost one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWS" /> Larger air tanks could be fitted to [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]] such as the [[Roamer-6 breath mask/Legends|Roamer-6]] to increase the amount of air available to the wearer.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
